0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0) come in on a two-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Northwest, one game back, and 4th in the West, while the Lakers (3-0) have won three straight, sit 1st in the Pacific, and are 3rd in the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 Portland won the series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17. Portland is missing Chris Youngblood and Shaedon Sharpe, both out, and Scoot Henderson is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero and Cameron Carr, both out.
